meta.description: The ORVIBO Smart Temperature & Humidity Sensor tracks your home's climate in real time, shows it on your phone and switches on the AC or humidifier by itself when it drifts out of the comfortable range.
temp_sec_1.fp_content: Senses the indoor temperature in real time, and you can check it on your phone.
temp_sec_1.fp_content2: Linked to your AC: set a temperature and the AC turns on by itself, so your home stays comfortable.
temp_sec2.bg_shadow: It watches temperature and humidity more closely than you do
temp_sec2.shadow:
The room is too hot,
but you only notice when you're short of breath?
temp_sec2.shadow2:
Your clothes go moldy in the wardrobe
before you find out the moisture absorber needs changing?
temp_sec2.shadow3:
A cold and a runny nose from the fan,
and only then you notice the AC is too cold?
temp_sec2.shadow4:
Your child gets a nosebleed,
and only then you realize the air is too dry?
temp_sec3.temp_sec3: Caring for your family starts here
temp_sec3.clearfix: Watches for unusual temperature and humidity
temp_sec4.tit: Live temperature and humidity readings for smarter care
temp_sec4.cont: Put the sensor in the kids' room and it tracks temperature and humidity in real time. If they drift out of the comfortable range, it turns on the right appliance by itself: when the air gets too dry, for example, the humidifier comes on, so no more nosebleeds for your child.
temp_sec5.tit: Smart automation that looks after you before you ask
temp_sec5.cont: Put the sensor in the bedroom. On summer nights, when the AC runs for hours and the room drifts out of the comfortable range, it picks this up and "smartly" sets the AC to the right temperature, for better sleep and care for everyone at home.
temp_sec6.tit: The little things you forget, it remembers for you
temp_sec6.s_p: Put the sensor in the living room: when it gets too warm, it turns on the AC by itself, like a thoughtful smart butler.
temp_sec6.s_p2: Put the sensor in the wardrobe: when the humidity gets too high, it reminds you to change the moisture absorber.
temp_sec7.clearfix: Ultra-low power design, longer battery life
temp_sec7.clearfix3: Tool-free install: just stick it up
